one_line: Early Yadava ruler who raised his house from Western Chalukya feudatories to sovereign lords of Devagiri in the late 12th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-deep brown Deccan complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed black mustache and short beard, sharp dark eyes with a focused calm gaze, default expression confident and composed with a hint of strategic intensity
appearance.hair: thick black hair drawn back into a short warrior’s knot at the crown, the front smoothed with no loose fringe, wrapped at the base with a narrow deep-red cloth band; no crown, only a simple gold forehead chain (tilaka-band) resting above the brows
appearance.costume: late-12th-century western Deccan royal-warrior attire: knee-length cream cotton tunic (angarkha-like) with side tie, worn under a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton war vest dyed muted indigo-blue; lower body in tightly wrapped ochre-yellow cotton dhoti folded to mid-calf for mobility, pleats falling straight in front; over the torso a diagonal deep-red cotton sash from right shoulder to left hip, subtly patterned with narrow gold lines; arms bare but adorned with plain gold armlets above the biceps and simple gold bangles; feet in dark brown leather sandals with side straps; on campaigns he wears a practical, slightly rounded steel helmet with a short nasal guard and a fabric lining, no extravagant crest; jewellery restricted to small gold stud earrings and a short, sturdy gold neck torque, avoiding heavy ornaments while maintaining royal dignity.
appearance.signature: a medium-length straight steel sword with a gently curving Indian-style hilt and disc pommel, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard at his left hip, and in his left hand a rolled palm-leaf map of Devagiri’s basalt hill fort showing cut escarpments, moat line and false approach routes

ref_desc: Bhillama V appears as a mid-30s Deccan warrior-king with an oval brown face, short knot of black hair, cream tunic under indigo vest, ochre dhoti, deep-red sash, simple gold ornaments, steel sword at the hip and a rolled fort-map, in cream, indigo, red, ochre, brown and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Bhillama V of Devagiri: a mid-30s athletic Deccan warrior-king with an oval brown face, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, neat mustache and short beard, black hair pulled into a compact warrior’s knot bound with a deep-red cloth band and a simple gold forehead chain above the brows. He wears a knee-length cream cotton tunic with side tie beneath a fitted sleeveless quilted war vest in muted indigo-blue, a tightly wrapped ochre-yellow dhoti folded to mid-calf, and a diagonal deep-red cotton sash with fine gold lines from right shoulder to left hip. Show small gold stud earrings, a short gold neck torque, gold armlets above the biceps and plain gold bangles, plus dark brown leather sandals. At his left hip hangs a medium-length straight steel sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with a subtly curving hilt and disc pommel, and in his left hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf map representing the engineered basalt hill fort of Devagiri. Use a palette of cream, indigo blue, deep red, ochre yellow, dark brown and gold; present him in neutral full-front, side and three-quarter stances to clearly show face, hair knot, helmet-free head, garments, jewellery, sword and map prop, with a calm, confident strategist’s expression.
